description: Sas vélos is a dataset listed in Ville-d'avray open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Seine Ouest. Localisation des SAS vélos sur Ville-d'Avray - Interdit aux cyclomoteurs, sauf disposition prise par par l’autorité investie du pouvoir de police. - Bande d’accès (sur une dizaine de mètres) non-obligatoire. Retrouvez la carte interactive "Circuler à vélo" sur SoCarto le portail cartographique de GPSO. Coverage: Ville-d'Avray. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements, Mobilité, Vélo. Its keywords are Ville d'Avray, Plan climat, SAS vélos, Vélos. The portal shows 25 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-villedavray-fr-portal.
